source_title: Sustained Price Rally for DRAM and NAND Flash into 4Q24 Is Possible If Suppliers Prudently Control Output, Says TrendForce
claim_relevant_visible_text: The persistence of this rally in memory prices during 2024 will largely hinge on suppliers’ ongoing and effective control over their capacity utilization rates.
researcher_paraphrase: TrendForce treated the 2024 DRAM/NAND price rally as dependent on continued supplier capacity-utilization control rather than attributing the broad rally solely to AI demand.
precision_guard: This January 2024 statement mixes an observed prior price reversal with a forward condition for sustaining the rally. It is not a realized full-year causal decomposition.
authority_boundary: TrendForce is methodological-primary for its own market measurement and forecast framing, not a primary supplier utilization ledger.
